title: noise.rossler
description: `noise.rossler` generates the x, y, and z values of a Rössler attractor using Heun’s method, providing chaotic noise through three outlets. Send it a bang to advance and output the values; its initial state and parameters can be supplied as optional float arguments or changed with messages such as `x`, `y`, `z`, `a`, `b`, `c`, and `dt`.
